title: console: the build fails on macOS (case-insensitive filesystem): WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.tsx and workspaceTimezonePrompt.ts differ only in case, so the component import resolves to the logic file
body:
Filing gate ①: a reproduced product defect (local macOS build of the pinned console). Filed under the maintainer's direct instruction in this session (2026-10-12: 「你测试遇到的问题创建issue」, then 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能创建 issue」).
Reader: objectui triage (routing), then the `domain:ui` lane's execution seat. The fix is a file rename in `apps/console`.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectui is:issue workspaceTimezonePrompt` → 5 hits, all states (this card plus #11908, #11758, #11801 and #11693, which are feature or i18n cards with no build defect). `… "case-insensitive" build` → 48, none about filename casing in the first page.

## What was measured

On macOS (APFS, case-insensitive by default), `pnpm build` of `@object-ui/console` fails at `tsc` on objectui `d758f2f20dd1`, which is cloud's current `.objectui-sha`. `origin/main` still carries both files.

```
src/AppContent.tsx(18,10): error TS2305: Module '"./pages/settings/WorkspaceTimezonePrompt"' has no exported member 'WorkspaceTimezonePrompt'.
src/AppContent.tsx(18,41): error TS1261: Already included file name '.../pages/settings/WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.ts' differs from file name '.../pages/settings/workspaceTimezonePrompt.ts' only in casing.
src/pages/auth/SetupPage.tsx(28,33): error TS1149: ...
src/pages/settings/__tests__/WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.test.tsx(41,10): error TS2305: ...
```

## Cause

`apps/console/src/pages/settings/` holds two modules whose paths differ only in case. Both came in with #11761 (objectui#11758, 2026-10-07):

- `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.tsx`, the component
- `workspaceTimezonePrompt.ts`, the logic

TypeScript tries `.ts` before `.tsx`. On a case-insensitive filesystem, the import `./pages/settings/WorkspaceTimezonePrompt` therefore resolves to the **logic** file `workspaceTimezonePrompt.ts`, which has no `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt` export. Linux CI is case-sensitive, so CI stays green.

## Reach

Every local macOS build of the console since 2026-10-07 fails this way. That includes cloud's `scripts/dev-local/run-stack.sh --with-ui`, which builds the console from the objectui checkout: it fails three attempts and aborts with `console build failed and no prior dist`. Measured 2026-10-12 while setting up a rig to reproduce objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2065.

## Workaround, verified

Renaming the logic module to `workspaceTimezonePromptLogic.ts` and updating its three importers makes `tsc` pass, and the console build then succeeds. The importers are `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.tsx`, `__tests__/WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.test.tsx` and `pages/auth/SetupPage.tsx`. No behaviour changes.

## Suggested fix

- Rename one of the two files so that no two paths in the repo differ only in case.
- Optionally add a CI check that fails on case-colliding paths (`git ls-files | sort -f | uniq -di`), since Linux CI cannot see this class of break.
